settings.headline:
Beautiful moments
with beautiful people.
settings.subline: Studio & portrait photography in Benin City • Available Worldwide
settings.bio:
I'm Zetona_E, a studio and portrait photographer based in Benin City. My aim is to capture beautiful moments of beautiful people.

Every session is an intimate conversation between light, presence, and emotion. Working with deliberate patience and bespoke lighting, I create portraits that honor who you are in this moment.
